y-m-57-01.title: Four correspondences: which are functions?
y-m-57-01.topic: Function meaning: one output for each input
y-m-57-01.goal: Judge using 'one output per input'. Show examples where different inputs same output and still function; explain how to fix non-function correspondence.
y-m-57-01.material:
A correspondence/rule gives output for input. Four examples below.
(가) Each student in class → their attendance number (already assigned).
(나) Positive integer x → positive divisors of x.
(다) Integer x → x squared.
(라) Real x≥0 → 'real y whose square is x.'
